title: Launch kit
produces: A launch poster drawn by the image model (four candidates, one seed per chunk across the phones), then the words of a two-page doctor detail aid written by the language model, from one brief: two different models in one job

params.prompt: clean modern pharmaceutical launch poster illustration for {item}, teal and navy tones, bright, photorealistic product on a plain background, no text, no logos, no faces
params.negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, blurry, distorted hands, deformed faces

params.template:
You write promotional copy for Kavira Pharmaceuticals. From the brief below write the poster headline and subline and the bullet points of a two-page doctor detail aid, plus a call to action for medical representatives. Make no clinical claims that are not in the brief and invent no figures.

Brief: {item}
